comment: The items (D-1038, D-1046). A used-up item holds a stack limit from 3 to 10, and a key item holds 1. A heal, a restore, and a revive give an amount, and a cure ends its statuses. The item rate of the battle rules cuts each amount in a fight (D-382). PR-13 moved the draught here from the battle fixture, and each id is permanent (D-166). The torch is a key item, and the torch rules find it by its id (D-1065). PR-30 tunes each number.
